sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fire moves and flying moves are 1.5× stronger.
Ice moves are halved (0.5×).

Clear Smog, Dig, Dive, Egg Bomb, Explosion, Gust, Icy Wind, Magnet Bomb, Ominous Wind, Precipice Blades, Razor Wind, Seismic Toss, Self-Destruct, Silver Wind, Smog, and Twister also count as Fire for type matchups.
Rock moves also count as Fire for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Clear Smog, Gust, Hydro Steam, Icy Wind, Infernal Parade, Ominous Wind, Precipice Blades, Razor Wind, Scald, Silver Wind, Smog, Steam Eruption, Thunder, and Twister: 1.5× stronger.
Eruption, Heat Wave, Lava Plume, and Magma Storm: 1.2× stronger.
Hydro Pump, Hydro Vortex, Muddy Water, Oceanic Operetta, Sparkling Aria, Surf, Water Pledge, and Water Spout: halved (0.5×).
Thunder: never miss.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fire-type.
Nature Power becomes Eruption.
Secret Power can cause burn.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Blizzard, Glaciate, and Subzero Slammer change the field into Mountain.
Bounce and Fly change the field into Sky.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Fire Mane: 2× power for Fire-type moves.
Long Reach: 1.5× damage.
Rocky Payload: 2× power for Rock-type moves.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Steam Engine: Speed +1.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Hail cannot be started here.
Snow cannot be started here.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Telluric Seed: Defense +1 and sets a shell trap.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
